defaults.setup: Install the exact core and CLI candidate tarballs into an otherwise empty temporary package and create the indexed real project.
defaults.action: Invoke the installed breakdown executable with exact argv, stdin, environment, and signal fixtures.

rows.oracle: Only the three cataloged human commands plus help and exact package version are accepted.
Missing/empty project is usage failure; a relative argument resolves from invocation cwd and no ambient root is selected.
Create always returns a new Run, inspect requires exact ID, and every forbidden human command is a usage failure.
Operate accepts one strict bounded request document and emits one schema-valid output document.
Human command values/failures/effects equal the matching dispatcher operation and contain no adapter-owned core behavior.
Machine success/failure stdout is exactly one reviewed compact JSON line and stderr is empty; human streams follow their exact channels.
Control fixtures are escaped within the stderr bound; color appears only on TTY and disappears for any NO_COLOR value.
Every success, usage, and failure kind exits with its exact cataloged integer, including success for valid incomplete inspection.
Decoded base64 bytes and ordered operation data equal the core values byte-for-byte and require no prose parsing.
SIGINT/SIGTERM cause no pre-commit record and exactly one complete record after the publication critical section.
The installed tarball executable passes identical traces with no Git executable/repository and no workspace import.
The public process corpus covers every command, request variant, stream, boundary, byte field, control, exit, signal, and ambient-root case.
